description:
One of the most common patterns seen across decades of working with couples is the belief that passion and long-term love cannot exist in the same relationship, and that if the spark has gone, the only place to find it is somewhere new.

Sensual embodiment teacher and Mindvalley trainer Rachel Pringle offers a reframe that changes everything. Erotic connection does not disappear because a relationship deepens. It disappears because the curiosity does. The person who has been shared a life with for decades is not a finished version of a human being. Neither is anyone else.

Do you think passion and long-term love can coexist?

Comment RACHEL and I'll send you the full conversation.

#MarisaPeer #RachelPringle #Relationships #Intimacy #DevotionalLove
